notes: No model is bundled. After signing in, add a connection in Admin Settings → Connections: OpenAI, Anthropic, any OpenAI-compatible API (for example this panel's LiteLLM recipe) or your own Ollama server's URL.

The built-in Ollama connection is switched off (ENABLE_OLLAMA_API=false), so nothing calls a local Ollama that does not exist. Open WebUI stores this setting in its database on the first start; turn it back on in Admin Settings → Connections if you add your own Ollama.

WEBUI_ADMIN_EMAIL and WEBUI_ADMIN_PASSWORD create the administrator only while no users exist, and creating that administrator closes sign-up, so a second sign-up is refused. Later changes to these variables do nothing: change the password in the web interface.
WEBUI_SECRET_KEY (generated) signs sessions and encrypts stored OAuth data; it persists with the application's secrets. WEBUI_URL is the site's own HTTPS address.

The official slim image is used on purpose: the full image downloads a local embedding model on its first start and took more than 15 minutes to become ready. The slim image has no local embeddings, reranking or speech-to-text; configure external providers for those features.
Everything (the SQLite database, uploads and settings) lives in one named volume on /app/backend/data.
Exact release tags were verified for linux/amd64. Tested lists remain empty until live verification on Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04.
